echo_bounce.day_96_in_4: translateY(-1px) on every beat for 2 ticks (166 ms, steps, no easing), then 0
echo_bounce.twilight_80_in_3: translateY(-1px) on beat 1 of each bar only, 2 ticks (confirmed, Kai Nov 1)

echo_bounce.shadow: none (Kai, Nov 1): same bounce for all families

flower_sway.pattern_day: beat n: f1 for 2 ticks then f0; beat n+1: f2 for 2 ticks then f0 (alternate)
flower_sway.pattern_twilight: beat 1 of each bar only, alternate f1/f2 (confirmed, Kai Nov 1)
flower_sway.tap_wins: a tap plays the existing fx_strip (1,2,1,0) and pauses the sway for that hotspot until it ends
